trails.note: Blue-square label (162,1058) sits in the open cut down the far west (image-left) edge of the Stateside area, between the boundary woods/Timbuktu glade and two brown-tree islands (x~205-320,y~905-1130 and x~250-370,y~1130-1320). Traced from the point of the upper island (254,904), where the Hotshot Derick cut and the foot of the Timbuktu glade feed in, down the left side of both islands past the label, then along the top edge of the base woods into the Jet Triple Chair run-out (~(402,1363)). The start is that junction (judgment); the thin strip between the two islands at y~972 is only a painted gap, not a route.

NO CUT: the diamond (149,771) sits in a uniformly sparse-tree glade (painted like Stateside Glade) between the yellow boundary (x~100-130) and the dense tree edge along the Hotshot Derick cut (x~250), from the summit ridge (y~580) down to where it opens into the top of Willard (~(190,950)). No open cut to follow; the label text's right end touches the Hotshot Derick cut but the symbol is in the glade.

Diamond (243,840) sits on a narrow open cut between the dense east edge of the Timbuktu glade and the tree islands west of Haynes. No other label on that cut: followed it up to the ridge traverse under the boundary at (262,570) and down to the point of the brown-tree island at (254,904), where it splits left into Willard and right into the meadow at the foot of Haynes; ended there. At y~675-695 it touches the Haynes cut under the big island (kept to its own left side). The unlabeled ridge traverse from the summit that feeds it (and Haynes/U.N./Timbuktu) is not included.

Diamond (329,712) sits in the cut between the big tree island (x~270-345) and the tree column west of U.N. Traced from the summit bowl at (385,500) down that cut past the label, then between the small islands (x~270-300) and the tree clusters (x~350-410) into the open meadow above the lower islands (~(346,948)), where it meets the top of the Mont l'Entrepide cut and openings to U.N. and Willard; ended there since the lower cut carries the Mont l'Entrepide label.

Blue square (357,1136) sits mid-way in the wide cut between the brown-tree islands (right edge x~315-345) and the narrow tree column west of U.N. (x~400-420). Traced from the meadow where Haynes ends (~(348,955)) down the centre of that cut past the label into the base run-out near the Jet Triple Chair (~(432,1360)). The start at the meadow is a judgment.

Both labels (diamond (421,618) up top; square (438,1024) lower, printed as a BLUE square) sit on one continuous lane just west of the Jet lift line, between the tree column along the lift (x~445-465 upper, ~455-490 lower) and the islands to its west. Traced from the summit bowl (428,500) straight down through the mid-mountain gap (y~945-960, where it briefly opens to the meadow and the lift line) and down the lower lane to the base run-out (~(485,1368)).

Both labels (diamond on the red lift line at (482,554); square at (536,1080), printed BLUE for the lower part) are on the Jet Triple Chair lift-line cut. Traced down the centre of the open snow along the lift (a few px east of the red line) from the summit (492,482) to the bottom terminal (~(530,1372)). Heaven's Road branches off its east side at ~(524,962).

Blue square (583,993) sits in the diagonal open band that leaves the east side of the Jet lift-line cut at ~(524,962) and runs down-right (ESE) under a thin diagonal row of brown trees to ~(730,1084), where it meets the lower Kitzbuehel cut (the parallel band above that tree row, continuing from Kitzbuehel's (611,857) label) and the Northway/Paradise Meadows corridor; ended at that junction. The label text also runs over the Kitzbuehel band, but the symbol is in the lower band. The open gap at y~945-965 continues west across U.N. to the Haynes meadow; not traced since nothing labels it Heaven's Road.
